Here are our lab's latest publications, pulled dynamically from PubMed: ```{{python}} #| echo: false #| output: asis #| cache: false import urllib.request import urllib.parse import json search_term = '("Muetzel R"[Author] OR "Muetzel RL"[Author])' email = "contact@ipni.nl" # NCBI requires a contact email for API use try: encoded_term = urllib.parse.quote(search_term) search_url = f"[https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=){encoded_term}&retmode=json&retmax=50&tool=ipni_website&email={email}" # NCBI requires a custom User-Agent header to prevent blocking scripts req = urllib.request.Request( search_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'IPNI-Lab-Website/1.0'} ) with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response: search_data = json.loads(response.read().decode()) id_list = search_data['esearchresult'].get('idlist', []) if not id_list: print("No publications found.") else: ids_string = ",".join(id_list) summary_url = f"[https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=){ids_string}&retmode=json&tool=ipni_website&email={email}" summary_req = urllib.request.Request( summary_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'IPNI-Lab-Website/1.0'} ) with urllib.request.urlopen(summary_req) as response: summary_data = json.loads(response.read().decode()) for pmid in id_list: pub = summary_data['result'][pmid] title = pub.get('title', '') authors_list = [auth['name'] for auth in pub.get('authors', [])] authors = ", ".join(authors_list) journal = pub.get('fulljournalname', '') pubdate = pub.get('pubdate', '') doi_info = [aid['value'] for aid in pub.get('articleids', []) if aid['idtype'] == 'doi'] doi = doi_info[0] if doi_info else "" print(f"**{title}**
") print(f"*{authors}*
") print(f"**{journal}** ({pubdate}). ") if doi: print(f"[DOI: {doi}](https://doi.org/{doi}) | ") print(f"[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/{pmid}/)") print("

") except Exception as e: print(f"Could not load publications at this time. Error: {e}")
